thesis: Drop of Honey removes the creature with the lowest power each upkeep without targeting, turning an empty or carefully managed battlefield into a slow green sweeper.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy the creature with the least power. It can't be regenerated. If two or more creatures are tied for least power, you choose one of them. When there are no creatures on the battlefield, sacrifice this enchantment.
